description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ORUR01Handler class within the OpenMRS HL7 module. It tests processing HL7 ORU^R01 messages, including creating encounters, observations, relationships, and handling complex data. It also verifies handling of form UUIDs, provider identification, and different data types.

classes.name: ORUR01HandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the processing of HL7 ORU^R01 messages by the ORUR01Handler, covering creation and updating of encounters, observations, relationships, and form handling.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateEncounterAndObsFromHl7Message
methods.description: Test that processing an HL7 message results in the creation of encounters and observations for the specified patient.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateObsGroupForOBRs
methods.description: Test the creation of grouped observations when processing HL7 messages with multiple OBR segments.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldAppendToAnExistingEncounter
methods.description: Test that observations are appended to an existing encounter if encounter_id is specified in the message.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateBasicConceptProposal
methods.description: Verify that a concept proposal is created when the message contains a specific key string.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateConceptProposalAndWithObsAlongside
methods.description: Verify creation of concept proposals along with observations from HL7 message.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldNotCreateProblemListObservationWithConceptProposals
methods.description: Ensure that no new observations are created for problem list entries when proposals are made.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateObsValueCodedName
methods.description: Test that observations set the valueCodedName correctly based on HL7 message.

methods.name: getConcept_shouldReturnAConceptIfGivenLocalCodingSystem
methods.description: Test retrieval of a Concept based on a local coding system code.

methods.name: getConcept_shouldReturnAMappedConceptIfGivenAValidMapping
methods.description: Test retrieval of a mapped Concept if an external code maps to an internal concept.

methods.name: getConcept_shouldReturnNullIfCodingSystemNotFound
methods.description: Test that null is returned if coding system mappings are not found.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldFailOnEmptyConceptAnswers
methods.description: Verify failure when processing an HL7 message with empty concept answers.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldFailOnEmptyConceptProposals
methods.description: Verify failure for empty or malformed concept proposal entries.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldCreateARelationshipFromANK1Segment
methods.description: Test the creation of person relationships from NK1 segments.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldFailIfTheCodingSystemIsNot99REL
methods.description: Test that an exception is thrown if the relationship coding system is invalid.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldFailIfTheRelationshipIdentifierIsFormattedImproperly
methods.description: Test failure when NK1 segment's relationship identifier is not properly formatted.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldFailIfTheRelationshipTypeIsNotFound
methods.description: Test that the process fails if the relationship type is not recognized.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldNotCreateARelationshipIfOneExists
methods.description: Verify that duplicate relationships are not created if one already exists.

methods.name: processNK1_shouldCreateAPersonIfTheRelativeIsNotFound
methods.description: Test creation of a new person in database when NK1 segment references a non-existent relative.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateAnEncounterAndFindTheProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Test creating an encounter associated with a provider identified by identifier.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateAnEncounterAndFindTheProviderByPersonId
methods.description: Test creating an encounter associated with a provider identified by person ID.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateAnEncounterAndFindTheProviderByProviderId
methods.description: Test creating an encounter associated with a provider identified by provider ID.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldCreateAnEncounterAndFindTheProviderByUuid
methods.description: Test creating an encounter associated with a provider identified by UUID.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldFailIfTheProviderNameTypeCodeIsNotSpecifiedAndIsNotAPersonId
methods.description: Test that an exception is thrown if provider identification method is invalid.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldUnderstandFormUuidIfPresent
methods.description: Test form UUID handling when processing encounter data from HL7 messages.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldPreferFormUuidOverIdIfBothArePresent
methods.description: Test that UUID is prioritized over internal ID for form association.

methods.name: processMessage_shouldPassIfReturnValueIsNullWhenUuidAndIdIsNull
methods.description: Test that getForm returns null if neither UUID nor ID is specified.

methods.name: getForm_shouldPassIfReturnValueIsNotNullWhenUuidOrIdIsNotNull
methods.description: Test that getForm returns a form when UUID or ID is specified in the message.
